text:
alex_ops: RMA ack — 6x A100 DOA from EU pod. Customs in AMS put the pallet on hold. RMA# RMA-124578, AWB 123-45678901. Need ETA for replacement + expedited cost. cc @sasha_procurement
rene_nexasupply: Sorry about this, Alex. We see the AWB and the customs hold. Customs flagged HS code mismatch on the commercial invoice. We're checking with our broker now. :mag_right:
maria_logistics: Can you paste the broker contact and the specific issue? I can call them.
rene_nexasupply: Broker says invoice used HS 8471 instead of 8473 for GPU modules — they want corrected paperwork and an end-use declaration. We can reissue docs same day but re-clear will add 6-12h processing; still stuck until customs reprocess.
sasha_procurement: Is reissue at NexaSupply's cost? This is a DOA replacement under warranty, PO# 42069. We shouldn't be charged for re-clear or expedite fees if vendor error.
rene_nexasupply: Correct — we will absorb the paperwork reissue. Expedited air uplift for partial replacement is a separate line item. For full air expedite of 6 units to AMS we'd quote ~$4,200 total (air + handling). For 3 units air + 3 ground it's ~$1,800. We can also consolidate to a bonded warehouse in NL to avoid duties, but that adds ~2 days.
alex_ops: We need at least 4 GPUs into our EU pool within 72h to avoid throttling jobs. Can you do 4x air and 2x ground, and confirm invoice coverage for the customs paperwork?
rene_nexasupply: Yes to paperwork coverage. We can do 4x air today EOD, 2x ground next-week. AWBs for the air shipments will be created after we get customs doc ack — ETA to AMS door ~24-36h after lift.
maria_logistics: Please attach the new commercial invoice with HS 8473 and the end-use form to the parcel manifest when you send the AWBs. Email broker@thirdpartybroker.com and cc me.
sasha_procurement: Also need a credit note for any uplift fees if this ends up being our responsibility. But assuming vendor absorbs paperwork, we won't charge expedite back. Confirm in writing.
rene_nexasupply: Confirmed in writing: NexaSupply will absorb paperwork reissue and customs re-clear fees related to the HS code error. Air uplift is a paid service per earlier quote unless covered under special SLA — we will waive expedite fee for this DOA batch given the circumstances.
carl_infra: Heads-up — cluster is at 65% GPU utilization this morning. If we lose more capacity we'll be forced to drain low-priority training jobs. Can we get a temporary buffer from spare pool? Need 4 GPUs to keep SLOs.
alex_ops: We're spinning up spare-hosted capacity now but cross-region latency sucks. If we can get 4 into EU within 36h we're fine. Otherwise we'll trigger canary scale-down for training.
carl_infra: Quick command I ran to crouch noncritical jobs: `kubectl scale deploy training-workers --replicas=4` — freed 8 GPUs, but those are transient.
sasha_procurement: Rene — while you're handling RMA, can you also confirm next allocation slot? We have a Q2 committed reserve and want to swap 6 replacement units into that slot if possible. PO# 42069 should cover the allocation credit.
rene_nexasupply: We can reserve the next allocation window (commit slot 2026-Q2-2) for you but need confirmation by EOD for allocation hold. If you confirm, we'll earmark the batch and move you up the queue.
sasha_procurement: Confirming now — please reserve and send a formal allocation hold notice. We will not sign extra invoices for hold.
rene_nexasupply: Allocation hold confirmed. I'll send a signed allocation notice to procurement@redwood.com and put the 6 units on hold against PO#42069.
rma_bot: RMA update: RMA-124578 status -> Replacement partial-air scheduled. AWB placeholders: AIR1: TBD-AIR-001, AIR2: TBD-AIR-002, AIR3: TBD-AIR-003, AIR4: TBD-AIR-004. Ground AWB(s): GND-TBD-101, GND-TBD-102.
maria_logistics: Once you have AWBs, ping me with tracking and customs docs PDF. I'll coordinate gallery clearance and notify EU customs rep.
rene_nexasupply: Will send docs in 45m. Also flag: for bonded warehouse routing we need written consent from Redwood customs agent to accept consignee-of-record change — that's a 1-hour sign-off from your side.
alex_ops: Maria can sign. @maria_logistics can you handle the consignee change?
maria_logistics: On it. I'll send the sign-off to Rene and broker within the hour.
carl_infra: If bonded routing goes through, any ETA delta compared to direct to AMS DC?
rene_nexasupply: Bonded adds ~30-48h in paperwork but avoids import VAT and accelerates handover for our inventory release — so ground to bonded could be faster for availability than stuck in customs.
sasha_procurement: Please also include the warranty transfer docs so the replacements register under Redwood's account. We need serial numbers on the invoice.
ene_note: (typo placeholder)
rene_nexasupply: Good catch — will include serials on the CI and warranty transfer forms.
alex_ops: Thanks team. Let's aim to have 4 GPUs physically available to infra in 36h. If anything changes escalate to #eng-sre and ping me directly. :thumbsup:
maria_logistics: Will update when AWBs arrive.
rene_nexasupply: AWBs created and docs emailed to Maria + Sasha. AWB list:
```
AIR: 123-45678901, 123-45678902, 123-45678903, 123-45678904
GND: 223-45678901, 223-45678902
```
rene_nexasupply: Tracker link: https://track.nexasupply.com/ship/123-45678901 (sent to Maria)
maria_logistics: Received docs and AWBs. Broker confirmed CI updated to HS 8473, end-use attached. Customs has lift request in queue.
carl_infra: Noted. I'll start warming the new nodes as soon as the first AWB shows in-transit.
sasha_procurement: Rene — please send the allocation hold notice and the waived-fee confirmation to procurement@redwood.com so we have it for audit.
rene_nexasupply: Sent allocation hold and waived-fee confirmation. Email subject: "Allocation hold 2026-Q2-2 — PO#42069 / RMA-124578"
alex_ops: Closing loop — thanks everyone. If customs release delays >12h escalate and we will discuss alternate routing (air express to FRA then truck to AMS).
maria_logistics: Will update.
rene_nexasupply: Will monitor and ping if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
